title: eleutherococcus setosus
intro: Eleutherococcus setosus, commonly known as the 'Siberian Ginseng', is a type of plant species belonging to the family Araliaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing stress, improving immune function, and enhancing physical performance. The bioactive constituents of this plant include eleutherosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other compounds such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids.
